details: This package ships a hidden install-time code-execution mechanism with no relation to its stated purpose. Its package.json declares a preinstall hook running setup.js; that script brotli-decompresses a hex-encoded blob and pipes the decoded text into the Bun runtime via child_process.spawn, looking for Bun at /usr/local/bin/bun, $HOME/.bun/bin/bun and $BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun, and exiting silently when Bun is not installed. The package's actual API is a single 34-byte index.js exporting a version string, so the install hook serves no functional purpose. In this version the embedded script is inert — it decodes to a single console.log("pkg init") statement — and the package makes no network requests, reads no environment secrets, tokens or.npmrc, and writes no files. The encoded-payload-plus-alternate-interpreter pattern is nonetheless a ready-made loader channel. No network IOCs were observed.
